name: Competitive intelligence
description: Scan public market signals, then synthesize a competitor brief.
briefPrompt:
Produce a Competitive Intelligence Brief for the company, product, or market in context.

Workflow:
1) Research — dated public signals (product, pricing, GTM, hiring, partnerships).
2) Analyst — synthesize.

Required sections:
## Thesis
## Competitor / market signals (dated + links)
## Business read (positioning, threats, opportunities)
## Options (2–3 moves)
## Recommendation
## Next actions
## References

Separate Fact vs Inference vs Recommendation. Do not invent URLs.

name: Policy & knowledge Q&A

Answer using the internal knowledge base first for the policy, process, or FAQ in context.

## Recommendation
## Next actions
